name: Hyder Amil's HAC VR
summary:
Hyder Amil's HAC VR turns real boxing padwork into a rhythm game for Meta Quest. Punch patterns arrive on the beat across jabs, crosses, hooks, uppercuts, slips, squats, and dodges. Timing and accuracy build your combo and score while the gym's reactive light show grows with your performance. Train your way:

• A growing catalog of tracks with handcrafted choreography
• Multiple difficulty levels and stance support
• Personal bests, leaderboards, streaks, achievements, guest profiles, and asynchronous frien
